sources.title: Adapting the Facebook Reels RecSys AI Model Based on User Feedback
sources.snippet: Our new User True Interest Survey (UTIS) model, now helps surface more niche, high-quality content and boosts engagement, retention, and satisfaction. We're doubling down on personalization, tackling challenges like sparse user data and bias, and exploring advanced AI to make recommendations even smarter and more diverse.

sources.title: RecSys 2022 - Tutorials - RecSys - RecSys
sources.snippet: Many state-of-the-art recommender systems adopt advanced machine learning techniques to model and predict user preferences from behavioral data. While such systems can provide useful recommendations, their algorithm design commonly neglects the underlying psychological mechanisms that shape user preferences and behavior.

sources.title: Adapting the Facebook Reels RecSys AI Model Based on User Feedback
sources.snippet: UTIS Alignment Model: A lightweight model layer trained on user survey responses, enhancing the main ranking system's performance. Practical Applications Use Case: Facebook Reels utilizes UTIS to boost high-interest videos and demote low-interest content, improving user engagement.
